name: Olivenza (Spain)
description: Divided per saltire, green at the hoist and fly and yellow above and below, charged at the centre with the full achievement of the arms of Olivenza (an olive tree and a castle on red with supporters, crown and the motto LA MUY NOBLE, NOTABLE Y SIEMPRE LEAL CIUDAD DE OLIVENZA).
history: Municipal flag of Olivenza; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
